title: Introduce graceful release drain hook and lightweight preflight verifier
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: We observed intermittent race conditions during release windows where a small burst of traffic combined with concurrent rollout jobs caused temporary 5xx spikes. This PR adds two orthogonal primitives: (1) a graceful release drain hook implemented as a lightweight controller that coordinates a short, deterministic connection quiesce window before changing routing rules; (2) a preflight verifier that runs a slim set of smoke checks (lint, schema validation, basic e2e smoke against a test model) as a gating step in the release pipeline. Goals: reduce transient errors at cutover, shorten investigation time by surfacing failing preflight checks, and keep developer feedback fast for day-to-day releases. Changes in this PR: - New release drain controller: cmd/release-drain (Go) with a simple leader election using existing raft lease; exposes an HTTP health endpoint and emits metrics to the console. The drain window is configurable per-release via release annotations. - Preflight verifier: ci/preflight/verifier (TypeScript) that executes a curated set of fast checks (lint subset, protobuf schema validation, lightweight model response smoke test). The verifier is invoked as an optional pre-merge job for non-critical changes and required for release/* branch merges. - CI pipeline updates: .github/workflows/release.yml updated to call the verifier and to POST drain requests to the coordinator during deployment orchestration. - Observability: added two new Prometheus metrics and a dashboard snapshot in observability/dashboards/release-drain.json. - Docs: docs/runbooks/release-drain.md with operational runbook and rollback guidance. Checklist: - [x] Implement release drain controller - [x] Add preflight verifier and integrate with workflows - [x] Add metrics + dashboard - [x] Update runbook and README - [x] Tests (unit + smoke) Backwards compatibility: The drain controller is opt-in via release annotations and defaults to disabled. Preflight verifier is enabled for release branches only; existing PRs to feature branches are unaffected unless contributors opt in. Rollout: merged to main behind feature flag and enabled for the next scheduled release window. Related: ENG-4982 (investigation into release flaps), ENG-5031 (preflight checklist for release automation).
commits: ci: wire verifier into release workflow
test: add unit + smoke tests for verifier and drain controller
review_comments: Marcus Lee: Nice approach to leader election — can we tolerate the existing 5s raft lease for clusters with high churn? Suggest exposing lease TTL as a config map entry.
Priya Nair (author): Good point — added leaseTTL in config and defaulted to 15s. We fallback to 5s if not set. See internal/drain/lease.go.
Elena Rodriguez: Preflight verifier looks clean; can we split lint subset to run only changed-language linters to shorten runtime?
Priya Nair (author): Implemented change-aware linter selection: verifier probes changed files list from PR metadata when available, otherwise runs full subset. Keeps normal runs fast.
Samir Patel: Observability looks good — add an alert for drain-window > 2m to catch misconfigured releases.
Priya Nair (author): Added alert rule and dashboard note in docs/runbooks/release-drain.md.
release_notes: Added opt-in release drain controller and a lightweight preflight verifier. Improves stability during cutover by coordinating connection quiesce windows and surfacing failing smoke checks before release. Configurable via release annotations and gated on release branches.
